title: Count Triplets That Can Form Two Arrays of Equal XOR
goal: Count triples splitting a contiguous interval into two equal-XOR parts.
strategy: The two parts have equal XOR exactly when the entire interval XOR is zero. An interval from left through right then offers right-left internal split positions.
